SELECT
    o.observstation AS observatory_name,
    COUNT(*) AS signals_meeting_threshold,
    AVG(sp.techsigprob) AS avg_origin_score,
    AVG(s.freqmhz / s.bwhz) AS avg_frequency_ratio,
    (COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM signals s2
        INNER JOIN signalprobabilities sp2 ON s2.signalregistry = sp2.signalref
        WHERE sp2.techsigprob > 0.5
    )) AS percentage_of_candidates
FROM
    observatories o
INNER JOIN telescopes t ON o.observstation = t.observstation
INNER JOIN signals s ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref
INNER JOIN signalprobabilities sp ON s.signalregistry = sp.signalref
WHERE
    sp.techsigprob > 0.5
GROUP BY
    o.observstation
ORDER BY
    signals_meeting_threshold DESC;

        WHEN bwhz / freqmhz < 0.0001 AND freqdrifthzs < 0.1 AND modtype NOT IN ('AM', 'FM', 'PM', 'QAM') THEN 'Strong NTM'
        WHEN bwhz / freqmhz < 0.0005 AND freqdrifthzs < 0.5 AND modtype NOT IN ('AM', 'FM', 'PM', 'QAM') THEN 'Moderate NTM'
        ELSE 'Not NTM'

    signalclass = 'Narrowband';

SELECT 
    o.observstation AS observatory_name,
    COUNT(s.signalregistry) AS total_signal_count,
    AVG(CASE 
        WHEN rp.analysisprio = 'High' THEN 3
        WHEN rp.analysisprio = 'Medium' THEN 2
        WHEN rp.analysisprio = 'Low' THEN 1
        ELSE 0 
    END) AS average_priority_score,
    AVG(sp.corrscore) AS approximate_CCS_values,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rp.analysisprio = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS important_signals,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sd.confirmstat = 'Confirmed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_confidence_signals,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rp.analysisprio = 'High' AND sd.confirmstat = 'Confirmed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS signals_meeting_both_criteria
FROM 
    observatories o
JOIN telescopes t ON o.observstation = t.observstation
JOIN signals s ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref
JOIN signalprobabilities sp ON s.signalregistry = sp.signalref
JOIN researchprocess rp ON s.signalregistry = rp.signalref
JOIN signaldecoding sd ON s.signalregistry = sd.signalref
GROUP BY 
    o.observstation
ORDER BY 
    signals_meeting_both_criteria DESC;

SELECT 
    o.observstation AS site_name,
    t.telescregistry AS telescope_id,
    -- Calculate the quality score
    (o.atmostransparency * 100) + 
    CASE 
        WHEN o.seeingprofile = 'Excellent' THEN 100
        WHEN o.seeingprofile = 'Good' THEN 75
        WHEN o.seeingprofile = 'Poor' THEN 25
        ELSE 0
    END AS calculated_score,
    -- List equipment problems
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT t.equipstatus) AS equipment_problems,
    -- Count the number of issues
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.equipstatus) AS issue_count,
    -- Determine confidence level based on seeing profile
    CASE 
        WHEN o.seeingprofile = 'Excellent' THEN 'High'
        WHEN o.seeingprofile = 'Good' THEN 'Medium'
        WHEN o.seeingprofile = 'Poor' THEN 'Low'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS confidence_level
FROM 
    observatories o
JOIN 
    telescopes t ON o.observstation = t.observstation
GROUP BY 
    o.observstation, t.telescregistry, o.atmostransparency, o.seeingprofile
ORDER BY 
    calculated_score DESC;

WITH SignalCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        t3.observstation AS observatory_name,
        COUNT(t1.signalregistry) AS total_signal_count,
        AVG(CASE WHEN t4.analysisprio ILIKE 'High' OR t4.analysisprio ILIKE 'Urgent' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS avg_priority_score,
        AVG(t2.corrscore) AS approx_ccs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t4.analysisprio ILIKE 'High' OR t4.analysisprio ILIKE 'Urgent' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS important_signals,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t2.corrscore > 0.9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_confidence_signals,
        SUM(CASE WHEN (t4.analysisprio ILIKE 'High' OR t4.analysisprio ILIKE 'Urgent') AND t2.corrscore > 0.9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS both_criteria_signals
    FROM 
        signals AS t1
    JOIN 
        telescopes AS t3 ON t1.telescref = t3.telescregistry
    JOIN 
        signalprobabilities AS t2 ON t1.signalregistry = t2.signalref
    JOIN 
        researchprocess AS t4 ON t1.signalregistry = t4.signalref
    GROUP BY 
        t3.observstation
)
SELECT 
    observatory_name,
    total_signal_count,
    avg_priority_score,
    approx_ccs,
    important_signals,
    high_confidence_signals,
    both_criteria_signals
FROM 
    SignalCounts
ORDER BY 
    both_criteria_signals DESC;

WITH SignalMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        sp.signalref,
        sp.corrscore,
        sp.anomscore,
        (s.bwhz / s.centerfreqmhz) AS bfr_measure
    FROM 
        signalprobabilities sp
    JOIN signals s ON sp.signalref = s.signalregistry
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN corrscore BETWEEN 0.9 AND 1.0 THEN 'High Correlation'
        WHEN corrscore BETWEEN 0.7 AND 0.89 THEN 'Medium Correlation'
        WHEN corrscore < 0.7 THEN 'Low Correlation'
    END AS score_classification,
    COUNT(*) AS signal_count,
    AVG(bfr_measure) AS avg_bfr_measure,
    STDDEV(anomscore) AS stddev_anomaly_metric
FROM 
    SignalMetrics
GROUP BY 
    score_classification
ORDER BY 
    score_classification;

7da3deec340a40cfc52bb233fbd1ec1b99347432.sql:
WITH SignalMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        t.observstation AS observatory_name,
        COUNT(s.signalregistry) AS total_signal_count,
        -- Assign numerical values to priority categories
        AVG(
            CASE rp.analysisprio 
                WHEN 'High' THEN 3
                WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2
                WHEN 'Low' THEN 1
                ELSE 0 -- Default for NULL or other values
            END
        ) AS avg_priority_score,
        AVG(sp.corrscore) AS avg_confirmation_confidence_score,
        SUM(CASE WHEN rp.analysisprio = 'Important' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS important_signals,
        SUM(CASE WHEN sp.corrscore > 0.9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_confidence_signals,
        SUM(CASE WHEN rp.analysisprio = 'Important' AND sp.corrscore > 0.9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS both_criteria_signals
    FROM 
        telescopes t
    JOIN 
        signals s ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref
    JOIN 
        researchprocess rp ON s.signalregistry = rp.signalref
    JOIN 
        signalprobabilities sp ON s.signalregistry = sp.signalref
    GROUP BY 
        t.observstation
)
SELECT 
    observatory_name,
    total_signal_count,
    avg_priority_score,
    avg_confirmation_confidence_score,
    important_signals,
    high_confidence_signals,
    both_criteria_signals
FROM 
    SignalMetrics
ORDER BY 
    both_criteria_signals DESC, high_confidence_signals DESC, important_signals DESC, avg_priority_score DESC;

    JOIN 
        researchprocess rp ON s.signalregistry = rp.signalref
    JOIN 
        signalprobabilities sp ON s.signalregistry = sp.signalref
    GROUP BY 
        t.observstation
)
SELECT 
    observatory_name,
    total_signal_count,
    avg_priority_score,
    avg_confirmation_confidence_score,
    important_signals,
    high_confidence_signals,
    both_criteria_signals
FROM 
    SignalMetrics
ORDER BY 
    both_criteria_signals DESC, important_signals DESC, high_confidence_signals DESC;

WITH interference_score AS (
    SELECT 
        telescref AS telescope_id,
        AVG(
            CASE 
                WHEN interflvl ILIKE '%high%' THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS interference_score
    FROM signals
    GROUP BY telescref
),
average_interference_score AS (
    SELECT AVG(interference_score) AS average_interference
    FROM interference_score
)
SELECT 
    telescope_id,
    interference_score
FROM interference_score
WHERE interference_score > (
    SELECT average_interference
    FROM average_interference_score
);

WITH interference_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        t.telescregistry, 
        AVG(
            CASE 
                WHEN s.interflvl = 'High' THEN 1
                WHEN s.interflvl = 'Medium' THEN 0.5
                WHEN s.interflvl = 'Low' THEN 0.25
                ELSE 0
            END + 
            CASE 
                WHEN s.atmointerf = 'Severe' THEN 1
                WHEN s.atmointerf = 'Moderate' THEN 0.5
                WHEN s.atmointerf = 'Minimal' THEN 0.25
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS interference_score
    FROM 
        telescopes t
    JOIN 
        signals s ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref
    GROUP BY 
        t.telescregistry
),
telescope_updates AS (
    SELECT 
        t.telescregistry, 
        CASE 
            WHEN isc.interference_score > 0.5 THEN 'High Interference' 
            ELSE t.equipstatus 
        END AS new_equipstatus
    FROM 
        telescopes t
    LEFT JOIN 
        interference_scores isc ON t.telescregistry = isc.telescregistry
)
SELECT * FROM telescope_updates;

WITH oow_criteria AS (
    SELECT 
        observstation,
        (weathprofile = 'Clear' AND seeingprofile = 'Excellent') AS meets_oow
    FROM 
        observatories
),
environmental_factors AS (
    SELECT 
        observstation,
        atmostransparency AS snqi,
        JSON_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'lunar_factors', JSON_BUILD_OBJECT(
                'lunar_stage', lunarstage,
                'lunar_distance', lunardistdeg
            ),
            'solar_condition', solarstatus
        ) AS env_factors
    FROM 
        observatories
)
SELECT 
    meets_oow,
    COUNT(observstation) AS station_count,
    AVG(snqi) AS avg_snqi,
    JSON_AGG(JSON_BUILD_OBJECT(
        'station_name', observstation,
        'snqi_value', snqi,
        'environmental_factors', env_factors
    )) AS detailed_env_factors
FROM 
    oow_criteria
JOIN 
    environmental_factors USING (observstation)
GROUP BY 
    meets_oow
ORDER BY 
    meets_oow DESC;

WITH oqf AS (
  SELECT 
    t1.observstation, 
    -- Calculate Observation Quality Factor (OQF)
    (
      t1.atmostransparency * t1.lunardistdeg * t2.pointaccarc
    ) AS calculated_score,
    -- Classify Observational Confidence Level (OCL)
    CASE 
      WHEN t1.atmostransparency > 0.5 
        AND t2.equipstatus = 'Operational' 
        AND t2.calibrstatus = 'Current' THEN 'High'
      WHEN t1.atmostransparency BETWEEN 0.3 AND 0.5 
        AND t2.equipstatus = 'Degraded' 
        AND t2.calibrstatus = 'Due' THEN 'Medium'
      ELSE 'Low'
    END AS confidence_level
  FROM 
    observatories AS t1
    JOIN telescopes AS t2 ON t1.observstation = t2.observstation
),
site_issues AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation, 
    ARRAY[
      equipstatus, procqueuestatus
    ] AS equipment_problems,
    -- Count the number of issues
    ARRAY_LENGTH(ARRAY[
      equipstatus, procqueuestatus
    ], 1) AS issues_count
  FROM 
    telescopes
)
SELECT 
  t1.observstation AS name,
  t3.telescregistry AS "telescope ID",
  t2.calculated_score,
  si.equipment_problems,
  si.issues_count,
  t2.confidence_level
FROM 
  observatories AS t1
  JOIN oqf AS t2 ON t1.observstation = t2.observstation
  JOIN telescopes AS t3 ON t1.observstation = t3.observstation
  JOIN site_issues si ON t1.observstation = si.observstation
ORDER BY 
  t2.calculated_score DESC;

WITH ranked_stations AS (
    SELECT 
        o.observstation AS observatory_name,
        COUNT(s.signalregistry) AS signal_count,
        AVG(sp.anomscore) AS avg_origin_score,
        AVG(s.freqmhz / s.bwhz) AS avg_frequency_ratio,
        COUNT(s.signalregistry) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(s.signalregistry)) OVER () AS percentage_candidates,
        RANK() OVER (
            ORDER BY COUNT(s.signalregistry) DESC
        ) AS rank
    FROM 
        observatories o
    JOIN telescopes t ON o.observstation = t.observstation
    JOIN signals s ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref
    JOIN signalprobabilities sp ON s.signalregistry = sp.signalref
    WHERE 
        sp.falseposprob < 0.01
    GROUP BY 
        o.observstation
)
SELECT 
    observatory_name,
    signal_count,
    avg_origin_score,
    avg_frequency_ratio,
    percentage_candidates
FROM 
    ranked_stations
ORDER BY 
    rank;

WITH station_conditions AS (
    SELECT 
        observstation AS station_name,
        atmostransparency AS aoi,
        lunarstage AS lunar_stage,
        lunardistdeg AS lunar_distance,
        solarstatus AS solar_condition
    FROM observatories
),
station_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        station_name,
        AVG(aoi) AS avg_aoi,
        json_agg(
            json_build_object(
                'station_name', station_name,
                'aoi', aoi,
                'lunar_factors', json_build_object(
                    'lunar_stage', lunar_stage,
                    'lunar_distance', lunar_distance
                ),
                'solar_condition', solar_condition
            )
        ) AS environmental_factors
    FROM station_conditions
    GROUP BY station_name
)
SELECT 
    (CASE WHEN avg_aoi > 0.5 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END) AS meets_good_conditions,
    COUNT(*) AS station_count,
    AVG(avg_aoi) AS avg_aoi,
    json_agg(environmental_factors) AS environmental_factors
FROM station_stats
GROUP BY meets_good_conditions
ORDER BY meets_good_conditions DESC;
